details: The Federal Reserve is widely anticipated to announce a 25-basis-point interest rate hike today, September 16, 2026, a move largely priced into the markets. Crypto investors are closely watching the accompanying policy statement and economic projections (the "dot plot") for clues on future monetary policy. A hawkish stance, signaling further tightening, could increase pressure on risk assets like cryptocurrencies, which are already experiencing volatility with Bitcoin trading near $75,800.
title: Fed Decision Looms: Market Braces for Rate Hike and Future Guidance

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, a proposed bill aimed at establishing a clearer regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies in the United States, failed to pass a procedural vote in the US Senate on September 15, 2026. This legislative setback has been identified as a significant factor in the recent decline in Bitcoin's price and has heightened regulatory ambiguity, negatively impacting sentiment across the broader cryptocurrency market.
title: US Senate Defeats CLARITY Act, Adding Crypto Regulatory Uncertainty

details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded substantial net outflows totaling $450.4 million on September 15, 2026, following the US Senate's rejection of the CLARITY Act. Fidelity's Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) and BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) experienced the largest withdrawals, signaling a decrease in institutional investor demand and contributing to the selling pressure observed in the Bitcoin market.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $450M Outflows Post-CLARITY Act Defeat
